summaryZh: Ndao实验室开展连接物理、工程、光学与量子光学的交叉研究，结合基础科学、纳米材料与结构设计和原型器件开发。页面列出超构器件、生物光子学、量子光子学及全光磁化翻转等方向。
researchQuestions: 如何结合纳米材料与结构设计，开发无源和有源光学原型器件？
methods: 实验与集成光学器件开发

evidence.quote: Our group is dedicated to interdisciplinary research that bridges , physics , engineering , optics , applied physics , and quantum optics . Our research is a synergetic combination of fundamental science, nanomaterial/structure design, and prototype device development in both passive and active devices. It spans scientific procedures from theoretic analysis to numerical simulations, nano-fabrications, experiments, and integrated optical devices.
